Versus -- 1) THE STATE OF JHARKHAND 2) THE DEPUTY COMMISSIONER GARHWA, PO AND PS AND DIST GARHWA 3) THE DISTRICT LAND ACQUISITION OFFICER CUM COMPETENT AUTHORITY GARHWA,
PO AND PS AND DIST GARHWA 4) THE ADDITIONAL COLLECTOR CUM ARBITRATOR GARHWA, PO AND PS AND DIST GARHWA 5) THE NATIONAL HIGHWAY AUTHORITY OF INDIA THROUGH ITS CHAIRMAN, OFFICE AT NATIONAL HIGHWAY AUTHORITY OF INDIA G5 AND 6 SECTOR 10 PO AND PS DWARKA NEW DELHI 6) THE PROJECT DIRECTOR NATIONAL HIGHWAYS AUTHORITY OF INDIA, PIV DURGAPUR NHAI COMPLEX SECTOR 2A BIDHAN NAGAR DURGAPUR PO AND PS BIDHAN NAGAR DIST BURDWAN ( W B) .... Respondents ----
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY KUMAR DWIVEDI ---

entities.label: RESPONDENT

entities.text: PROJECT DIRECTOR NATIONAL HIGHWAYS AUTHORITY OF INDIA
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: For the Petitioner :- Mr. Binod Kumar, Advocate For the State :- Mr. Manav Poddar, Advocate For the NHAI :- Mrs.Sweety Topno, Advocate Mr. Amrit Raj Kisku, Advocate ----
Prayer in this petition has been made for payment of higher amount of compensation.

2. Learned counsel for the respondent State as well as NHAI submit that compensation is already decided in favour of the petitioner however, the petitioner is aggrieved with quantum of compensation and as such the petitioner is having alternative remedy under section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 in light of the provisions made in section 3-G(6) of National Highways Act, 1956.
3.
In view of above, this petition is disposed of with liberty to petitioner to avail alternative remedy in light of the above provisions.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) SI/,
